text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and understand why it happens. Fortunately, many debugging tools can help you, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution. However, using tools alone is not enough. You should also follow a systematic approach: check your code carefully, test one part at a time, and make changes gradually. Another useful technique is logging. By adding print statements or log messages, you can see what your program is doing and track down errors more easily.
